item.text: {"deduplicate":true,"instruction":"Explore exact SQL rewrites. Before expensive benchmarking, run the public SQL language contract and reject failures; reject repeated canonical SQL for the same task. For q01/q05, test moving a shared COUNT(*) FILTER predicate into WHERE and replacing the filtered count with COUNT(*) only when retained groups and all other outputs remain equivalent. For q05, if profiling implicates EXTRACT(day), test half-open timestamp ranges covering days 1–7 of every relevant month, preserving date coverage, timezone, and NULL semantics. Verify result equivalence, then use repeated timings against baseline; neither observed rewrite establishes a speedup. Use failures to guide distinct subsequent proposals. Keep external scoring unchanged.","preflight":true}
